meta.name: NevaGate Design DNA
meta.description: Design tokens and style extracted from nevagate.anext.dev — dark, tech-forward AI SaaS landing page.

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast (dark bg, light text) with blue accents for emphasis

typography.font_style_notes: Single typeface used across all weights; hierarchy driven by weight, size, and tracking.

spacing.section_rhythm: large gaps between sections (80–120px), consistent internal padding (24–32px)

layout.alignment_tendency: centered with asymmetric accents (e.g., sweep text, angled corners)

elevation.shadow_style: none; depth achieved via glassmorphism (backdrop blur) and layered backgrounds
elevation.depth_cues: backdrop blur, overlapping layers, subtle gradient borders

iconography.preferred_set: Lucide or Heroicons (inferred from common usage)

motion.philosophy: smooth, purposeful; animations enhance hierarchy without distraction

components.button_style: solid blue with glass backdrop; hover: scale or glow
components.input_style: dark background with subtle border, focus: blue ring
components.component_notes: Angled corners (notch) used as a signature shape across cards, panels, and containers.

aesthetic.era_influence: modern dark UI (2020s) with glassmorphism and micro-interactions

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle (gradient text, dot grid, notch corners)
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: balanced; hero area heavier, sections spaced evenly
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element (headline with animated text) plus supporting cards
visual_language.contrast_level: high (dark background, light text, blue highlights)
visual_language.texture_usage: dot-grid background, subtle scan line animation (scan keyframe)

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast (large display headline) + spatial isolation
composition.balance_type: asymmetric (notch corners, sweep text, but overall centered)
composition.negative_space_role: defines breathing room, separates content clusters

imagery.illustration_style: none; relies on typography and subtle gradients
imagery.graphic_elements: dot grid, trace lines, notch shapes
imagery.pattern_usage: dot-grid background (radial gradient) and marquee logos

interaction_feel.feedback_style: instant, with subtle transition (scale, opacity, blur)
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: low; purposeful micro-interactions (caret blink, sweep text, reveal)

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative ('Get Started', 'Build More, Spend Less')

background_effects.description: Subtle dot-grid pattern overlay; text-sweep gradient animation on headline

text_effects.type: gradient sweep on headline, caret blink
text_effects.description: Animated gradient background on text; blinking cursor-like caret

visual_effects.composite_notes: The design uses a cohesive set of visual motifs: notch clip-path for containers, glassmorphism, dot-grid background, and animated sweep gradients. Motion is used sparingly but effectively to draw attention and guide flow.
